This indicates that Pethidine may influence Grin2b through a shared pathway involving Nmda Glutamate Receptor Activity. The scores from the two paths are slightly different, with Pethidine showing a marginally higher score in binding to Grin2a compared to Grin2c, but both pathways converge on Grin2b as a downstream target. The evidence suggests a possible functional interaction, though the exact mechanism and the strength of the relationship remain to be fully elucidated.
